test_title: PYST 10 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

"The government will be implementing the new environmental regulations next month."

options.text: The new environmental regulations will be implemented by the government next month.
The new environmental regulations will be being implemented by the government next month.
The new environmental regulations are being implemented by the government next month.
The new environmental regulations will have been implemented by the government next month.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The active sentence "will be implementing" is in the **Future Continuous Tense**.
 
• **Passive Structure for Future Continuous:** The formula is **Object + will be + being + Past Participle (V3) + by + Subject**.
 
• **Step 1:** Move the object "The new environmental regulations" to the beginning.
 
• **Step 2:** Change the verb "will be implementing" to "will be being implemented."
 
• **Step 3:** Add the agent "by the government" and the time phrase "next month."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The new environmental regulations will be being implemented by the government next month."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "will be implemented" – This is the Future Simple Passive. It misses the continuous "being" aspect.
 
• **Option 3:** "are being implemented" – This is the Present Continuous Passive, which changes the timeframe from future to present.
 
• **Option 4:** "will have been implemented" – This is the Future Perfect Passive, used for actions that will be completed by a certain point.
